title: A drone attacks a seller in Ukraine

paragraphs: A shocking video from Ukraine shows a Russian drone chasing a street vegetable seller named Yuri in Kherson. Although the drone exploded nearby and injured him, Yuri miraculously survived. Ukrainians call these disturbing civilian attacks a human safari, where Russian operators use drones to target ordinary citizens instead of military forces.

Drones have completely transformed the modern battlefield. Russian troops employ various models, including fast kamikaze drones, commercial quadcopters, and advanced fiber-optic drones that cannot be easily jammed by radio signals. Both Ukraine and Russia have established specialized military branches dedicated to drone warfare where technology evolves every few weeks.

Beyond drone attacks, Russia continues to strike Ukrainian cities with deadly ballistic missiles. Recent missile strikes killed at least twenty-one people and hit a rural railway station and surrounding warehouses. Ukrainian air defenses are struggling because they are running out of critical interceptor missiles, which leaves civilians vulnerable to continued destruction across the country.

paragraphs: A dangerous video shows a Russian drone chasing a street seller named Yuri in southern Ukraine. The drone exploded, but Yuri survived with injuries. People call these attacks on regular citizens a human safari.

Drones are now very important in this war. Russian soldiers use different types of drones to attack people and military locations. Some drones travel very fast, while others use long cables so their signals cannot be blocked. Technology changes quickly, and both armies now have special drone teams.

At the same time, heavy attacks continue to destroy buildings and harm people. A recent attack on a train station killed eight citizens. Ukraine needs more missiles to stop these dangerous air attacks, but its supplies are running low. Because of this, many people remain in danger every day.

paragraphs: There is a video of a Russian drone. The drone is following a man in Ukraine. The man sells vegetables on the street. The drone explodes near him, but he lives.

Russian soldiers use many small drones to attack people and cars in cities. Drones are now very important in the war. Some drones fly very fast. Some drones use long wires. These drones are hard to track.

Today, both Ukraine and Russia have special teams for drones. Russia also uses big rockets to attack towns. One rocket hits a train station and kills eight people. Ukraine needs more help and more air defense to stop these bad attacks and save lives.
